definitions.explanation: The organ of smell and breathing on the face.

examples.english: To have a high nose; to be proud.

notes:
{鼻|はな} refers to the nose.

NOTE ON HOMOPHONES:
- {鼻|はな}: nose
- {花|はな}: flower
Distinguished by pitch accent.

EXPRESSIONS:
- {鼻|はな}が{高|たか}い: to be proud
- {鼻|はな}を{折|お}る: to humble someone
- {鼻|はな}で{笑|わら}う: to sneer at
- {鼻|はな}が{利|き}く: to have a good sense of smell
